meaning:
καθότι
(= καθ᾽ ὅ τι),
adv., [in LXX: Exo.1:12, 17 (אֲשֶׁר), Tob.1:12, Jdth.2:13, al. ;]
1. in dl., according as, just as (Ex, l.with): Act.2:45 4:35.
2. In late Gk. = διότι (Tob, l.with), because: Luk.1:7 19:9, Act.2:24 17:31.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.
whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.
